0.name: TEXT_CTSMKDTRANSPOINT_00924_SYSTEM_000_000
0.description: You have attuned yourself to an Aethernet shard and now have access to the isle's Aethernet.
0.translation_description: Ti sei sintonizzato con un frammento dell’Aethernet e ora puoi usare la rete di trasporto dell’isola.

1.name: TEXT_CTSMKDTRANSPOINT_00924_SYSTEM_000_010
1.description: Additional shards can be found across the Occult Crescent. Attune to them to facilitate faster travel throughout the island.
1.translation_description: Altri frammenti si trovano in tutta la Mezzaluna Occulta. Sintonizzati con essi per spostarti più rapidamente sull’isola.
